summary: Security and consent audit of 35a059c..8ceb628 for track weekly_update_fix Phase 1. HEAD matches the audited sha. The leak gate refuses before git add with one 'update: leak <path>' line, exit 2, and no commit (update.sh:228-248), and the raw leak-check line never reaches stdout (update.sh:235-239; update-leak.test.ts:173-178, L1-L4 green). The --docs refusal without the record is update.sh:77-80 and test A3. update.sh holds no push: its only git calls are add, diff --cached, and commit (update.sh:248-254). No key shape, key value, or private data path appears in the range diff; .gitignore:23 covers .tmp/ so the private folder cannot enter a commit. No docs/ file changed in the range (git diff --stat -- docs/ is empty). Review A findings F1 to F6 were checked and confirmed still present at this HEAD; they stay with the routed fix round and are not repeated here. One new nonblocking nit: a scanner error with empty stdout yields an empty-path refusal line; it fails closed. tracks.md claims no resolved security state for this track, so A6 needs no adversarial check; the plan's Green r4 evidence lines match my runs.
